headline: Discord rolls out global automatic age verification after user backlash
summary: Discord began rolling out a new automatic age estimation system worldwide, following backlash over earlier verification measures. The company says most users will not need to verify their age, and offers several privacy-focused options for those who are not automatically confirmed as adults.
